section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a three-step analytic strategy using path analysis (Mplus 6.11): initial model fit in a larger US sample, model refinement via modification indices, and multi-group testing of the final model across the US and a smaller non-US sample. It specifies fit indices used (CFI, TLI, RMSEA) and estimation method (mean- and variance-corrected maximum likelihood) but provides no sample sizes, demographic details, measures, or correlation statistics.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Analysis proceeded in three steps... First, the fit of the hypothesised model (see Fig. 1) was investigated in the larger US sample... Second, the model was improved by adding additional paths, guided by modification indices (see Fig. 2). Third, the final model was fit to the data of both the US and the smaller non-US sample using multi-group analysis... Mplus 6.11... mean- and variance-corrected maximum likelihood estimation... For the evaluation of model fit, the comparative fit index (CFI), the Tucker–Lewis index (TLI), and the root mean square error of approximation (RMSEA) with 90 % confidence interval were used."
